item.title: Fanmade Port of Nintendo 64 Classic Perfect Dark Running On Quest
item.description: A fanmade port of Nintendo 64 classic Perfect Dark is coming to Quest.

item.title: Apple Acquired "Silent Speech" Startup Q.ai
item.description: Apple acquired Q.ai, reportedly for $1.6 billion, a startup working on converting "silent speech" into text. The technology could be crucial for AR glasses.

item.title: Bad Bunny's Me Porto Bonito Comes To Beat Saber
item.description: Beat Saber gets Me Porto Bonito (feat. Chenco Corleone) by Bad Bunny in latest shock drop.

item.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles VR Coming In Spring, New Gameplay Trailer Revealed
item.description: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Empire City launching onto VR headsets this spring, and a new gameplay trailer has been revealed.

item.title: Polyarc Games Announces Glassbreakers Tournament With $1,000 Prize Pool
item.description: Polyarc Games has announced a tournament for Glassbreakers later this month with a $1,000 prize pool.

item.title: Nintendo Switch Virtual Boy Classics Might Be Playable On Labo VR
item.description: Though not officially supported, Nintendo's upcoming Virtual Boy library may be playable on Labo VR, the DIY cardboard headset from 2019.

item.title: GOLF+ Shares Update On Mixed Reality Golf Simulation
item.description: GOLF+, shared a new video showcasing an in-development mixed reality golf simulator.

item.title: A Fisherman's Tale Developer Announces New VR Spy Title
item.description: InnerspaceVR, the studio behind popular titles like Maskmaker and A Fisherman's Tale, just announced a brand-new VR game titled Spymaster.

item.title: Snap Spins Out AR Specs Into Its Own Subsidiary
item.description: Snap spun its Specs AR glasses into its own subsidiary, and reconfirmed that it plans to launch the consumer product this year.

item.title: Valve To "Revisit" Steam Frame Shipping Schedule & Pricing
item.description: Valve says it needs to "revisit our exact shipping schedule and pricing" for Steam Frame and Steam Machine amid the global memory shortage.
